text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on York Mills Road, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval to install traffic control signals at the intersection of York Mills Road and Upjohn Road. The traffic control signals will provide enhanced safety for all road users and are justified based on the assessment undertaken.
City Council on October 8 and 9, 2025, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the installation of traffic control signals at the intersection of York Mills Road and Upjohn Road.
